articles.title: 346th AEW Defenders sharpen skills to counter small unmanned aircraft
articles.summary: Specialized, hands-on training provided by the 346th Air Expeditionary Wing builds the capability for Airmen and teams to counter small unmanned aircraft systems, or sUAS. That capability protects expeditionary air bases and sustains air operations in the U.S. Southern Command area of responsibility.

articles.title: U.K. Carrier Strike Group Concludes 6-month Operation Firecrest Deployment
articles.summary: Royal Navy aircraft carrier HMS Prince of Wales (R09) returned Monday to its homeport of Portsmouth, concluding the U.K. Carrier Strike Group’s two-phase Operation Firecrest deployment. The deployment spanned six months and took the carrier strike group the Atlantic and High North.

articles.summary: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Japan District (USACE JED) experts led elementary students through hands-on infrastructure and electrical engineering lessons during the annual STEAM Day at Shirley Lanham Elementary School on Nov. 6.

articles.title: U.S. Navy Sailor takes first place in the 2026 Norwegian Foot March 30K
articles.summary: Naval Aircrewman (Helicopter) 2nd Class Simon Ginsberg was the first participant to cross the finish line at the 2026 Norwegian Foot March, completing the 30-kilometer course in 3 hours and 18 minutes at Naval Air Facility (NAF) Atsugi, Japan, Nov. 14, 2026.

articles.title: Stryker Leader Symposium Synchronizes Force Modernization
articles.summary: FORT CARSON, Colo. – The 4th Infantry Division hosted senior leaders from across the U.S. Army and the Royal Thai Army for the Stryker Leader Symposium Nov. 3-4 to synchronize modernization and redesign efforts.

articles.title: U.S. Marine Corps Forces South Hosts Regional Symposium to Strengthen Hemispheric Defense
articles.summary: NEW ORLEANS – U.S. Marine Corps Forces, South hosted senior leaders with marine and naval infantry forces from 12 Latin American countries during the Regional Marine Leaders Symposium, Nov. 4-6.

articles.title: Sharon Chen, a New York City resident, retires from New York Army National Guard after 24 years of service
articles.summary: New York Army National Guard 1st Sgt. Sharon Chen, a Monroe resident and veteran of three Middle East deployments, retired after more than 24 years of military service during a Nov. 7 ceremony at the Whitestone Armory in Queens.

articles.title: Fort Buchanan helps service members turn military experience into business opportunities
articles.summary: Soldiers, veterans and military family members explored opportunities to turn their skills and ideas into businesses during a Boots to Business workshop hosted by Fort Buchanan in partnership with the U.S. Small Business Administration Nov. 17 at the installation's Training Support Center.

articles.title: NORAD TO CONDUCT LONG-PLANNED AIR DEFENSE EXERCISE IN NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION
articles.summary: The North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) will conduct Exercise FALCON VIRGO, a long-planned monthly live-fly air defense exercise on Nov. 18, 2026, between midnight and 2 a.m. EST in the National Capital Region.

articles.title: New Hampshire National Guard breaks ground on new Plymouth Readiness Center
articles.summary: The New Hampshire Army National Guard broke ground on the new Plymouth Readiness Center, a $31 million investment in Soldiers, readiness and the future of the Granite State. The 38,288-square-foot facility will replace Plymouth’s 1957 armory with modern, secure space to support training and missions for years to come.

articles.title: Pentagon fails ninth straight audit despite progress in organizing finances
articles.summary: The Pentagon failed a financial audit for the ninth consecutive year, according to an inspector general report, but an official said a majority of its units passed for the first time.

articles.title: USAG Stuttgart community member helps lead team to All Army softball win
articles.summary: A physical therapy technician assigned at the U.S. Army Health Clinic Stuttgart joined fellow Soldier-athletes from across the globe to claim the Defense Department’s top softball title at the USA Softball Hall of Fame Complex.

articles.title: USAG Rheinland-Pfalz honors employee’s 57 years of service
articles.summary: KAISERSLAUTERN, Germany – A Department of the Army Food Service Supervisor serving at U.S. Army Garrison Rheinland-Pfalz is retiring after more than 57 years of service to the United States military. Mike Young began his career as an Air Transportation specialist with the U.S. Air Force in 1968.

articles.title: USAG Rheinland-Pfalz observes Germany’s National Day of Mourning
articles.summary: KAISERSLAUTERN, Germany — U.S. Army Garrison Rheinland-Pfalz leaders joined host nation officials at ceremonies across the Kaiserslautern and Baumholder communities to honor victims of war, terrorism, persecution and tyranny as part of Germany’s National Day of Mourning, or Volkstrauertag, Nov. 15.

articles.title: Penn State Altoona Student Spotlight: Kevin McCallum
articles.summary: Penn State Altoona student Kevin McCallum, a second degree nursing major, is a married father of two who is active-duty in the National Guard and expected to graduate in December.

articles.title: Armaments Center partners with Rowan University to advance next generation lightweight metamaterials
articles.summary: PICATINNY ARSENAL, N.J. - The U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Armaments Center has entered into a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with Rowan University in Glassboro, effective Wednesday, Sept. 23.

articles.title: Navy introduces Joint Warfighter Evaluation pilot for future flag officers
articles.summary: Announced in NAVADMIN 264/26, the U.S. Navy’s Joint Warfighter Evaluation (JWE) program, hosted by the U.S. Naval War College (NWC), will put senior flag-eligible officers through challenging wargame scenarios to further determine their fitness to promote.

articles.title: GVSC, Michigan National Guard partner with industry to advance formation-based layered protection
articles.summary: More than 100 Soldiers, government engineers, and industry partners converged here recently for a two-week tactical experiment designed to test how multiple protective technologies can work together to enhance formation-level survivability and protection.

articles.title: U.S. Marines Join Local Okinawan Residents for 50th Annual Henoko Sports Day
articles.summary: U.S. Marines with 4th Marine Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, joined Okinawan residents for the 50th Annual Track and Field Meet Sports Day, a traditional Japanese sports festival, on Nov. 1, 2026.

articles.title: Senate appropriators unveil $1.1T Pentagon spending bill, folding in reconciliation priorities
articles.summary: Nearly $69 billion in money sought by the White House through reconciliation will be rolled into the base budget under the Senate appropriator’s plan.

articles.title: Penn State Lioness returns to Inspire Future STEM Airmen
articles.summary: In a flight suit neatly adorned, an Air Force Reserve Major General returned to her alma mater to inspire and engage the next generation of Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics students who share the opportunity to launch their Reserve journeys.

articles.title: Bridges of Peace: Kure Pier 6 safety officer promotes community safety, local history off duty
articles.summary: Yuji Matsushin, a safety officer with 30 years of service at U.S. Army Pier 6 in Japan, leverages his role and personal volunteer work as a historic tour guide to promote community safety, preserve Hiroshima's legacy, and foster international friendship.

articles.title: Funeral Honors highlight Oregon National Guard service to the community
articles.summary: The Oregon National Guard's Funeral Honors represents the state as "The Service of Choice” for Oregonians. The Oregon National Guard's Citizen-Soldiers and Airmen provide protection, response, and readiness whenever the state or nation calls.

articles.title: Chemical, biological threats put Nevada Civil Support Team to the test
articles.summary: The Nevada National Guard’s 92nd Civil Support Team passed its readiness evaluation Oct. 20-22 at the Truckee Meadows Water Reclamation Facility in Sparks, Nevada, meeting standards in every critical task and mission-essential task assessed.

articles.title: From couches to crew quarters: USACE Sacramento District builds aircrew readiness at Beale Air Force Base
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Sacramento District is constructing an $11 million Aircrew Readiness Facility at Beale Air Force Base, California, to support the 940th Air Refueling Wing. The facility will provide dedicated sleeping quarters and mission support spaces for up to 40 airmen.
